description: Confirmed real bug: EntityConfig::paper() defaults new papers to Classification::unsorted() (topics=['unsorted']), but no topics/unsorted/kovan.toml directory is ever created, so KnowledgeIndex::children_of('') never surfaces it and an unclassified paper is currently invisible in the Wiki browser -- papers_in('unsorted') would find it, but nothing lets the user navigate there. Add a synthetic 'Unsorted' entry at the Wiki root (shown whenever index.papers_in("unsorted") is non-empty) that sets current='unsorted' on click, reusing the existing drill-down/papers_in machinery -- no new collection directory needed.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Implemented in commit e7759d5a (develop). See op-sr4n's own tracking / the commit message for details.

title: activate_paper: 4: Unsorted inbox visible/navigable in Wiki
